cd "C:/Users/sever/documents/projeto2/dsai-ap2-trim" && git fetch -q origin && git switch -q -c docs/sessao-2026-11-25-final origin/main && S="C:/Users/sever/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/9a8fd64311062c47/667ff31e-58ea-4ab6-a0f6-8951c7c4d926/scratchpad" && CUT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) && echo "corte=$CUT" && python -I ../export_safe.py "C:/Users/sever/.claude/projects/C--Users-sever-documents-projeto2/667ff31e-58ea-4ab6-a0f6-8951c7c4d926.jsonl" "$CUT" "$S/full.jsonl" --mascarar *** 2>&1 | tail -3 && python - "$S/full.jsonl" "$CUT" <<'EOF'
import json, sys
src, cut = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
start = "2026-11-25T18:31:57Z"
kept = [l for l in open(src, encoding="utf-8") if start < json.loads(l).get("timestamp", "") <= cut]
first = min(json.loads(l)["timestamp"] for l in kept)
print("linhas na parte:", len(kept), "primeira:", first)
ids = {json.loads(l)["message"].get("id") for l in kept if json.loads(l).get("type") == "assistant"}
print("message.id do agente:", len(ids - {None}))
open(r"C:/Users/sever/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/9a8fd64311062c47/667ff31e-58ea-4ab6-a0f6-8951c7c4d926/scratchpad/parte.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8").writelines(kept)
EOF
